### Auth Flow (3)
- `GET /_api/v1/access-tokens` — Get access tokens (authentication flow).
- `POST /$rpc/{$rpcToken}/GenerateIT` — Generate an IT token (authentication flow).
- `POST /identitytoolkit/v3/relyingparty/verifyCustomToken` — Verify a custom token for authentication.

### Data Read (15)
- `GET /_api/chat-web/v1/chatrooms/{chatroomId}/enriched` — Get enriched chatroom data.
- `GET /_api/chat-web/v1/display-data/current-user` — Get current user's display data.
- `GET /_api/tag-manager/api/v1/tags/sites/{siteId}` — Get tag manager tags for a site.
- `GET /{id}` — Get details for a specific worker by ID.
- `GET /api/get_widget.php` — Retrieve a specific widget.
- `GET /faqs/client` — Get client FAQs.
- `GET /news/latest` — Get the latest news updates.
- `GET /pagead/1p-conversion/{1p-conversionId}/` — Read data for a 1P conversion.
- `GET /pagead/attribution/wcm` — Get page attribution data.
- `GET /pagead/conversion/{conversionId}/` — Get conversion data.
- `GET /pages/pages/thunderbolt` — Retrieve content from a specific page.
- `GET /services/auto-frontend-modules/1.6238.0/webworker/manifest-worker.min.json` — Retrieve the web worker manifest.
- `GET /services/editor-elements/1.14885.0/{1.14885.0Id}` — Get editor element data.
- `GET /tag-bundler/api/v1/fonts-cache/googleAPI/css` — Get CSS for Google API fonts.
- `GET /wp-json/contact-form-7/v1/contact-forms/{contact-formId}/feedback/schema` — Get contact form feedback schema.

### Data Write (8)
- `POST /_api/chat-web/v1/{v1Id}` — Write data to a chat endpoint.
- `POST /_api/presence-service/v1/set-data` — Set presence data.
- `POST /{id}` — Submit data associated with a specific ID.
- `POST /actionp/0` — Submit a work action (alternative endpoint).
- `POST /api/v1/bulklog` — Submit bulk log data.
- `POST /serverless/chat-event-reporter/report-event` — Report a chat event.
- `POST /v1/{v1Id}` — Submit data associated with a specific ID.
- `POST /wa/` — Submit a work action.

### Realtime (1)
- `GET /core-chat/participants/{participantId}/events.json` — Get real-time chat events for a participant.

### Config (2)
- `GET /consentconfig/{consentconfigId}/settings.json` — Get consent configuration settings.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Comfyworkers's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Comfyworkers data without official API access
- Automate actions on comfyworkers.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Comfyworkers frontend uses
